svg.aria-label: Animated request/response architecture: user request through CloudFront and API Gateway, JWT check with Keycloak, Spring Boot service querying PostgreSQL, 200 OK response back to the user, then a Kafka event consumed by notify and realtime services, with a synced trace waterfall
svg.text: Authorization: Bearer <jwt> → Keycloak verifies token + role
routed to project-svc · controller → service → repository
SELECT * FROM projects WHERE tenant_id = ? → rows returned
200 OK application/json → back through Gateway + CDN to the user
async: event on Kafka → email sent + WebSocket push to the user
✔ round trip complete · user got the response + a live update
